comment: Hand-labeled seed questions: a developer's sentence, and the declarations that answer it. No query names an identifier the code uses, because the point is mapping words onto nodes. Label a declaration `<file>#<name>`, or `<file>#<Type>.<method>` when a method name is shared.

seeds.query: where does an order get persisted?
what checks the caller's permissions before a handler does anything?
which function turns an order into the text a client sees?
where is the route that creates a new order?
what sends the notification once an order is accepted?
where are amounts turned into a readable string with a decimal point?
what validates the request body before the handler accepts it?
which type holds a person's name and email address?
where are the orders kept in memory?
what extracts the domain out of an email address?
which function records that payment has been taken?
where does the project declare what makes something an entry point?
what decides whether an address looks like a real one?
which contract lets a caller ask how many orders are held?
where is the outbound delivery channel chosen?
what adds up the price of several priced parts?
where does the liveness endpoint live?
which function reports how many lines an order has?
